title: Game crashes on Level 3 load
description: The game crashes to desktop when the player tries to load Level 3.

title: Crash when entering Level 3
description: Application closes unexpectedly when entering Level 3 from the main menu.

title: Character falls through floor
description: The player character falls through the floor near the bridge in Level 2.

title: Player drops through bridge
description: Character falls through the bridge surface in Level 2.

title: Audio disappears after pause
description: Game audio stops playing after pausing and resuming the game.

title: Sound missing after resume
description: No game sound is heard after the player resumes the game from the pause menu.

title: Inventory UI overlaps
description: Inventory icons overlap when more than 20 items are displayed.

title: Inventory icons cover each other
description: Items in the inventory visually overlap when the inventory contains many items.

title: Game crashes when opening settings
description: The game crashes when the player opens the settings menu.

title: Settings menu causes crash
description: Application closes when the settings screen is opened.
